goal: Add read-only imm-kernel inspect --json that projects current Kernel layout, claim, workspace, Assurance Projection, and risk-floor facts, labeling Capability, rehearsal, and CAS holder state as unobservable, without changing status --json or implementing GitHub #16.

acceptance.assertion: imm-kernel inspect --json returns assurance_kernel/inspect/v1 with layout, claim, workspace, idle floor prefixes, unobservable capability/rehearsal/cas_holder, and no fabricated task; a readable claimed task includes Assurance Projection plus declared/resolved risk and matching scope_hint entries; unreadable claimed record or intent fails closed; inspect writes no journal or .imm/state paths; missing --json is invalid_command; status --json remains assurance_kernel/status/v1.
